COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE
MINUTES

A meeting of the Committee of the Whole was held on Wednesday, January 4, 2023, in Council
Chambers and via electronic meeting, starting at 6:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: President Richard Johnson, Chairman; Dr. Michelle Aldrich,
Bryan Cook, Ken Esquibel, Richard Johnson, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Mark Rinne, Scott Roybal, Tom
Segrave and Jeff White.

Sep Si RA SN AE EL RSE
AGENDA ITEMS

13, ORDINANCE -3" READING — Amending various sections of Chapter 15.08, 15.09,
15.10, 15.12, 15.16, 15.22, 15.24 and 15.26 of Title 15, Buildings and Construction, of the
Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, updating specified building code
requirements and fees adopted by the city. (SPONSOR - MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. Cook moved to approve on 3“ and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried with
Mr. Segrave voting “NO”.

Antony Pomerleau, Interim Chief Building Official, provided a staff report. Committee member
Laybourn commented on the item.

14. ORDINANCE — 3 READING — Amending Section 2.84.050, Intemational Fire Code
Board of Appeals, of Chapter 2.84, Miscellaneous Boards and Commissions, of Title 2,
Administration and Personnel, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming,
pertaining to the International Fire Code Board of Appeals. (SPONSOR - MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. Cook moved to approve on 3 and final reading, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Division Chief Byron Matthews, Fire & Rescue Department, provided a staff report. Committee
members Aldrich, Esquibel, and Roybal commented on the item.

15. ORDINANCE -3" READING — Amending various sections within Chapter 8.12,
International Fire Code Adopted, of Title 8, Health and Safety, of the Municipal Code of
the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, updating the edition of the Intemational Fire Code
adopted by the City and further amending as specified. (SPONSOR ~ MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. Roybal moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Mr. Cook. Mr. Segrave moved
to amend by adding back into the document under section 8.12,030 letter “F” and renumber the
document as necessary, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion failed with Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Cook, Mr.
Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn, and Mr. Roybal voting “NO”. Main motion carried with Dr. Rinne and
Mr. Segrave voting “NO”.
